variables.name: prospect_timezone
variables.description: One of: America/New_York | America/Chicago | America/Denver | America/Los_Angeles — mapped from the prospect's spoken friendly zone per the conversion table in this tool's description.

description:
Capture `{{prospect_timezone}}`. The prospect NEVER speaks IANA — they speak friendly names. Convert using this EXACT table, no guessing:
• says "Eastern", "EST", "EDT" or "New York time" → store "America/New_York"
• says "Central", "CST", "CDT" or "Chicago time" → store "America/Chicago"
• says "Mountain", "MST", "MDT" or "Denver time" → store "America/Denver"
• says "Pacific", "PST", "PDT" or "LA / California time" → store "America/Los_Angeles"
Confirm with a yes/no question when possible (<So that's Central time, correct?>). If their zone is none of these four or unclear, ask which city they're near and match it to the closest of the four. Store ONLY these exact values.
Set contact_details_completed to true ONLY after: When first name, last name, company, timezone and best number are all collected and verified. Do not set it early.
